notes.title: patch v1.08a: more fixes :)
notes.content:
patch v1.08:
- cookpot should no longer cease to exist
- adjusted road signs
- you can make new save files again
- save system tweaks



AND patch v1.08a:

- fixed save file issue for certain regions



If you were effected by the save file issue, here's how you can fix it:

Head to C:\\Users\\YOUR_USERNAME\\AppData\\LocalLow\\SamC\\EasyDeliveryCo

in file explorer and edit the save file with notepad

You'll have to edit the fields:
'deliveryMoney:'
and 'deliveryFuel:'

For fuel place a '.' after the first one or two numbers (eg: "7040854" should be "7.040854")

And same goes for money (eg. "1415134" should be "14.15134")

Save, and relaunch the game and it should be fixed :)



Have an Easy day! (and so sorry for the trouble!!)

notes.title: Progress Update on Easy Delivery Co.! 150K wishlists, truck upgrades & more
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 



Hope y’all are doing well. Little note today to say that progress on Easy Delivery Co. is going well. The game is now feature complete! That means it’s now time to put all the bits and pieces together. On top of this nice milestone, 150,000 people have wishlisted the game!! Thank you so much for your support it means a lot.



So, if you don’t mind, I’d like to share with you some of the new stuff that will be featured in the game.


Truck Upgrades


You will be able to buy some upgrades for your truck at a very reasonable price from store keepers around the area. Snow tires are now available for purchase to reach new areas.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300666/1732ffd78641cf248fc95499851a77c9e5db5086.png"]


Spending Money and Consumables


Cool tools for your truck are not the only things you can purchase, coffee is a brand new alternative to energy drinks to live your liquid-based diet to the fullest.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300666/f24c346f58750393f247a0384f05c60f2f5874b6.png"]


Chill between deliveries


In between deliveries, you can explore the various regions (yes, plural) to your heart’s desire. If you wish to slow things down a little more, feel free to buy some bird seed and hang out with the local crows. Also just, recently added - fishing! 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300666/2ba29c11b672a65a2018a6e11536c9d54691da2d.png"]

Fishing Village 


New area!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300666/a45c8be3b1d4f5d53fd74508452db45b4ade3253.png"]


People have also shared some cool art on the discord!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300666/b829ab85920e456908960c7afc21049d5f0e6d65.png"]



That's it for now, thanks for reading and see you very very soon for more news on the launch :) In the meantime feel free to join the discord to hang out.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300666/7de1fcc11e2d5b146e6a1217168758495a662e4f.png"]

notes.title: New Demo Update! Steering sensitivity, controller mapping, fixes.. and horn
notes.content:
Hello hello everyone

What a couple of weeks it's been! Tons of people have played the Easy Delivery Co. demo, about 30.000 of you to be exact, and it's been a blast to see your reviews, your art, your feedback on the game. Thank you for playing and thank you for taking the time to leave reviews, it has really helped Easy Delivery Co. a lot. And we can't wait to show more about the game very soon :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45300666/e075d9cc65657e3d32d2a8053945b0e90b5a4809.png

This update includes some fixes of course, but also fun stuff like new music, the truck can now honk, and steering sensitivity settings. You can find all the patch notes at the bottom of this post!

Some Questions & Answers 

Does the demo run on Steam Deck? 
- Yes, we've seen people play on Deck or ROG Ally seamlessly so far. 

When will the game launch?
- Late 2025 

Will there be more to do with the truck?
- Yes

How many secrets will be in the full game?
- Yes

Will there be achievements? 
- Yes

Will there be more areas to explore? 
- Yes

Patch notes
 added brand new music tracks
 added horn
 added speed chime
 steering sensitivity setting
 crt effect setting
 alternate controller mapping
 dog sequence fixes
 fixed packages on npc head softlock
 packages can be placed under the fuel station

Thanks for reading and see you next time! I will leave you with some lovely fan art from the community in the meantime. Come hang out in the Discord to check out some videos, art, and speedruns of the game.

Fan art & fun images!!!

notes.title: The Easy Delivery Co. Demo is now available!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we're happy to announce that there is a shiny, brand new, demo for you all to try out. This announcement also comes with other news, Oro Interactive is now the official publisher for the game.

In Easy Delivery Co., take on the role of a delivery driver in a once-lively scenic mountain town now plagued by strange weather. Explore an ordinary town filled with odd secrets as you make deliveries and get to know its mysterious residents. Manage your energy, fuel, and temperature while navigating the challenges that come with each package.

Come hang out in the Discord!

Play the Easy Delivery Co. Demo now
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3293010/Easy_Delivery_Co/


Features
 Earn a "living" by delivering packages with your kei truck
 Take in the atmospheric scenery or blitz through (road safety not required)
 Buy drastically overpriced gas and get to know the locals
 Simple controls and retro graphics
 Listen to cool beats while driving
 Split-screen race mode with up to four players
 Nothing strange going on, no lore, nothing at all, we promise
